requirements.text: Proven experience shipping production AI or backend systems in a high ownership environment, with a recent focus on LLM-powered applications.
Expertise building retrieval systems using RAG and hybrid search, including chunking and indexing strategy, embeddings, vector and lexical search,

Expertise building developer tooling that lets developers build production agents, which can include frameworks for multi-agent orchestration, an agent and tool registry, and shared infrastructure for tracing and evaluation.
across systems such as retrieval and indexing, LLM provider integrations, and agent orchestration, including driving adoption and evolving the platform as usage grows.

Demonstrated technical leadership: you lead significant projects, design solutions for non-trivial problems by weighing tradeoffs, and influence architecture and execution beyond your immediate workstream.
Strong track record delivering complex projects with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, or phases.
Strong backend engineering fundamentals and proficiency in languages such as Ruby on Rails, Python, JavaScript, or Go, with SQL and RDBMS experience (PostgreSQL preferred).
Hands-on experience with the AI application lifecycle: experiment setup, dataset curation, offline evaluation, error analysis, deployment, and online evaluation.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving clarity: you can frame problems, propose solutions, and align others.
Strong communicator across functions, able to explain technical ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences and to translate complex concepts into business impact.
Ownership mindset and bias for action. You raise the bar for the team through mentoring, code review, and your own work.
Curious and continuously learning, with an agent-forward approach to how you build software.
Experience with pgvector or other vector indexes, and with query performance at scale.
Experience with content ingestion from third-party systems (document stores, knowledge bases, CRM knowledge objects) and the lifecycle problems that follow: sync state, dedupe, source conflict.
Experience processing conversation or call transcripts, including handling PII and consent constraints.
Experience designing evaluation suites that score qualities such as thoroughness and faithfulness, not only correctness.
Experience with voice or real-time conversational agents.
Experience with enterprise SaaS (especially B2B marketing or sales tech) or Salesforce/CRM integrations.
Startup experience and rapid shipping.
Strong backend engineering fundamentals and proficiency in languages such as Ruby on Rails, Python, JavaScript, or Go, with SQL and RDBMS experience (PostgreSQL preferred).
